firstFactOriginal:
An Albion anthem on blue vinyl.

Ray King’s “West Bromwich Albion” dates from 1979. Dave Bowler’s club retrospective remembers the blue-vinyl release and its tribute to Ron Atkinson. The reggae connection goes beyond The Liquidator.
